profile_block_description: You will no longer see each other's content. If either of you follows the other, those follows will be removed.
profile_unblock_description: They will be able to view and interact with your content again. Previous follows will not be restored.
profile_followers_empty_description: Followers will appear here once this profile has them.
profile_following_empty_description: Following users will appear here once this profile follows them.
exception_blocked_relationship: You cannot interact with this user because one of you has blocked the other.
exception_blocked_user_in_group: A blocked user cannot be added to this group.
exception_cannot_follow_blocked_user: You cannot follow this user because one of you has blocked the other.
exception_own_blocked_state_only: You can only change your own blocked status.
exception_users_not_found: One or more users could not be found.
